It is said that the last warrior of the Nightmare Knights, Krendorak, was mortally wounded by dragons and died beneath the Plains of Havoc. You descend into the dragon lair, find his body under a fire field and get a {item:Brown Bag} with the {item:Ornamented Shield}, a {item:Might Ring} and other items. With a partner's help you also open a second chest with a {item:Red Bag} containing a {item:Time Ring}.
It is said that the last warrior of the Nightmare Knights was mortally wounded by dragons and ended up dying beneath the Plains of Havoc.

1. Going down to the dragon lair
Get to the Plains of Havoc

The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are **southwest of Venore** ({coord:32747,32258,7}). Set off from **Venore** and walk **southwest** to the plains. The dragon lair is **west** of the Plains of Havoc temple.
Go to the **Plains of Havoc** and use the {item:Shovel} on the indicated hidden hole to go down.
Hidden hole in the Plains of Havoc
Maps of the three floors (Pic 1, 2 and 3) with the X where to use the pick
On the 1st floor below the surface fight a single {creature:Dragon}. Then go down the ramp.
On the 2nd floor there are 2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. You can fight one at a time if you block one of them in the narrow passage. Go down the ramp again.

On the 3rd floor follow the corridor **south** to an open room full of treasure. There are 2 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and several Dragons. Kill them carefully, using the corridor to pull them one at a time.
The {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} are the biggest danger of the quest. Don't enter the room unprepared.
Use the {item:Pick} on the spot marked with **X** on the map (Pic 3) and go down the hole.
Down there is a {creature:Fire Devil} and several {item:Fire Field|fire fields}. Walk through them.
Destroying the fire field and opening the body

Use the {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the fire field with a body showing up beneath it. It's Krendorak's body, one of the last Nightmare Knights. Open it and take the {item:Brown Bag} with the {item:Ornamented Shield} and the other items.
Leaving without doing the second part

If you don't have a partner for the Red Bag, leave the same way: use the {item:Rope} to climb up the pick hole to the main room on the 3rd floor, follow the corridor **north**, go up the ramps on the 2nd and 1st floors and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you came down through to return to the surface of the Plains of Havoc. From there, Venore is to the **northeast**.
Entrance/exit hole in the Plains of Havoc
3. The chest behind the stalagmites (Red Bag)
For this part you need a partner.
Use the {item:Rope} to climb up the hole back to the main room on the 3rd floor.

In the **southwest** corner there are {item:Stalagmites} blocking the way to a rope hole. To remove them, your partner has to stand on the square immediately **southwest** of the fire field in the **northwest** corner of the room.
With the stalagmites removed, go behind them and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest}. You receive a {item:Red Bag} with a {item:Time Ring} and other items.

You have two options: go back the way you came (if your partner is still holding the stalagmites: corridor to the **north**, ramps up and {item:Rope} on the entrance hole) or use the {item:Rope} on the hole next to the chest and come out in the Plains of Havoc, near the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}). From the Plains of Havoc, walk back **northeast** to Venore.
